kjv: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim
mine: In the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah
note: MT has "Jehoiakim" (repeated from 26:1), but the chapter concerns Zedekiah (vv. 3, 12; 28:1 "in that same year... Zedekiah"); a few Hebrew manuscripts and the Syriac read "Zedekiah", which I follow. The KJV keeps the MT, creating a chronological contradiction.
